title: Install a Flatpak application
summary: Install a specific application from a configured remote source (like Flathub).

steps.explain: Installs the specified application ID from the given remote source.

placeholders.name: REMOTE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the remote repository (e.g., flathub).

placeholders.name: APP_ID
placeholders.description: The unique identifier of the application (e.g., org.gnome.Calculator).
